title: What Is Shadowrealm? A Free Dark Fantasy Browser RPG Explained
subtitle: A plain-language look at the free browser RPG: how it plays, what it costs and who it suits.
description: What is Shadowrealm? A free dark fantasy browser RPG with ranks, four cities, PvP, crafting and a stronghold. See how it plays and whether it is worth your time.
card: What Shadowrealm: Age of Darkness is, what you do in it, what the optional purchases are, and who will enjoy this free dark fantasy browser RPG.

faq.a: Yes. The core game is free and needs no download, only an account. Shadowgems are an optional in-game currency sold as one-time purchases with no subscriptions, and you can progress without buying any.

faq.q: Do I need to download anything to play Shadowrealm?
faq.a: No. Shadowrealm: Age of Darkness runs entirely in a web browser. You create an account, make a character and play. Your character lives on the server, so your progress is waiting whenever you log back in.

faq.q: How many ranks and cities are there in Shadowrealm?
faq.a: There are eight ranks, from Peasant to Wraithking, and four cities: Ashenvale, Shadowmere, Duskholm and The Dark Citadel. The cities unlock at ranks 1, 3, 5 and 7. After rank 8 you can Ascend and climb again.
